tasks.title: Accept a search mode and keep keyword answers byte for byte
steps: Add the mode behaviours to a new src/worker/search/hybrid.test.ts and confirm they fail

Read mode in the GET handler of src/worker/search/routes.ts: absent or 'keyword' runs today's code path untouched, so its answer stays byte for byte; 'hybrid' is accepted; anything else answers 400 invalid_mode with field 'mode' and the message 'mode takes keyword, hybrid', checked after the query and before the limit
With mode=hybrid and no free word (an empty or blank query, or filters only), answer as keyword search does (streamPage) with meaning: 'used' added, embedding nothing

Document mode, invalid_mode and the hybrid answer in src/worker/api/openapi.ts (the 200 schema a union of SearchResults and a HybridResults that adds match to items and meaning at the top) and in the Search section of docs/api.md

tasks.title: Rank keyword and meaning matches in one ranking
steps: Add the ranking, match and snippet behaviours to src/worker/search/hybrid.test.ts and confirm they fail

Give findPassages (src/worker/meaning/passages.ts) two options without changing GET /api/v1/passages: a deadline in milliseconds (default 5,000) and the most passages per link (default 3), so a hybrid search can ask for the best passage of each of up to 100 links

In src/worker/search/search.ts expose what the fusion needs from keyword search: the ordered ids of the keyword matches under the filters (at most 1,000 for the fusion, then the rest), and which of them match on title, tags or topic (an FTS5 match restricted to those columns with matchExpression)

Write src/worker/search/hybrid.ts: the meaning candidates are the links of findPassages(words, filters, limit 100, one per link) scoring at least the threshold; the tier of a link is first when its keyword match is on title, tags or topic, else second; within a tier order by the sum of 1/(60 + rank) over the keyword ranking and the meaning ranking it appears in, then pinned position, more recently used, id; keyword matches past the first 1,000 follow in keyword order below the fused links of their tier

Mark each item match 'keyword', 'meaning' or 'both'; a meaning item's snippet is one unmarked segment with the first at most 32 words of its best passage, a keyword or both item's snippet the one keyword search gives (snippets read for the page's links only)

Page the fused ranking with a signed cursor {s: 'h', o} through encodeCursor and decodeCursor; refuse a keyword cursor in hybrid mode and a hybrid cursor in keyword mode as invalid_cursor; list matching workspaces on the first page only
Answer {items, workspaces, next_cursor, meaning: 'used'} from the hybrid branch of src/worker/search/routes.ts
Describe the hybrid ranking in the Search section of docs/architecture.md and in docs/api.md

Give e2e/fake-meaning.ts the switches POST /__fail (every embed and query answers 503) and POST /__recover, and the fakeMeaning helper of e2e/helpers.ts fail() and recover(), for the end-to-end flow in which Workers AI is unreachable
Document meaning: 'unavailable' and the 600 ms deadline in docs/api.md

tasks.title: Keep a hybrid search under 800 ms for 10,000 links
steps: Add the 10,000-link timing test to src/worker/search/hybrid.test.ts beside the keyword one of src/worker/search/search.test.ts and see where it stands
Where it is over 800 ms at the 95th percentile, bring it under: read keyword ranks and snippets only as far as the fusion and the page need, and look the meaning candidates up in one D1 query
Leave the keyword path as it is, so that the existing 500 ms test of keyword search keeps passing
